_readme: Site-wide facts. Edit here, then run: python3 _build/build.py. Lists marked A-Z are checked by the build (cities, more). site_url = the ONE canonical base (no trailing slash): canonicals, og:url, sitemap and schema @id all derive from it; switch it when Maz names the domain. nav = the 3 header links in comp order (home_href = same-page anchor on the homepage); more = About/Contact/FAQ/Service areas, A-Z (footer + phone menu). form.endpoint empty = the quote sheet falls back to call/text (never a 405). email stays empty until Omar confirms a working inbox (the live site shows info@milehighcustomremodels.com, but that domain's DNS is not live yet). phone.texts = also offer "Text" (off: the copy deck has Call only until Omar confirms the number takes texts). home_jobs = the homepage 2x2 (Bathroom 1 stands in for Kitchen 1 while K1 is unpublished).
name: Mile High Custom Remodels
